device_analysis.description: Vertical grating coupler with 4 tapered fingers and bottom access port
device_analysis.function: Couples light from/to vertical fiber incidence through periodic grating structure

key_features.grating_fingers: 4 vertical teeth, tapered from wider at top to narrow at base
key_features.access_port: Tapered vertical port at bottom for waveguide connection
key_features.taper_shape: Linear taper from ~2.7 μm wide at top to ~1.05 μm at base

topology_plan.step1: Create a rectangular bus waveguide (width ~2.8 μm, length ~25 μm, at y=0)
topology_plan.step2: Create 4 tapered fingers (trapezoids) extending upward from bus
topology_plan.step3: Create tapered access port (narrow at bottom, wider upward) at center bottom
topology_plan.step4: Parametrize all key dimensions as top-level tunables

function_defining_knobs: finger_width_um: width at base of taper (FUNCTION KNOB)
bus_width_um: vertical extent of bus waveguide
finger_taper_top_width_um: width at top of finger
port_width_um: width of access port at narrowest
port_height_um: height of access port taper
port_taper_ratio: width at top / width at base of port

iterations.change_made: Initial parameters from visual inspection of device image
Reduced grating_period to 5.2 to tighten finger spacing
Reduced grating_period to 4.85 and finger_width to 1.05, narrowed taper to 2.7

final_metrics.convergence: Plateauing near 0.38 IoU; diminishing returns visible

bus_width_um.description: Vertical extent of the bus waveguide

finger_width_um.description: Width of each finger at the base (main function knob)

finger_height_um.description: Vertical height of each grating finger

finger_taper_top_width_um.description: Width of each finger at the top (taper apex)

port_width_um.description: Width of access port at narrowest point (bottom)

port_height_um.description: Height of the tapered access port

notes.implementation: Primitives-only: rectangles for bus, trapezoid polygons for fingers and port
